Name: Bara Anthro Obelisk And Furniture
Author: RUBBERBARK
Description:
Tired of watching the original obelisk? It's okay, let the sturdy bara anthro give you a ride!

This mod integrates the environmental characteristics or exploration content of the transmission destination into the design of the obelisk texture to a certain extent. For example, for the mountains, there is bear miner; for the seaside, there is shark fishermen; for the desert, there is mysterious hunter wearing skull masks; for the island, there is lizard explorer; and a hairy bull will take you back to a warm farm. Without exception, they were all sweating profusely and revealing huge juicy cocks.On the other hand, this mod will have a chance to turn the original furniture into furniture with special textures. Change the tree of the winter star to reindeer anthro, three pornographic statues, as well as several paintings and rugs. Because furniture with special textures is randomly obtained, you don't have to worry about not being able to obtain furniture with default textures.

[b]How to use[/b]: You need to download these two front-end mods in order to use them properly: Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. This mod is divided into two parts. When you unzip the file, you will get two folders and put them separately into the mod folder. If you don't want any content other than the obelisk, you don't need to put this folder in the mod folder: "[AT]Bara Anthro Furniture".

If you want to directly obtain furniture with special textures, you can use the tools provided by Alternative Textures (purchased from Robin).

I'm sorry that I didn't consider the feelings of most players and made you feel uncomfortable. I'm truly sorry, and I will avoid such things from happening in the future. I reset the cover. And I made another version wearing underwear, removed the nipples, removed two paintings, and also made some adjustments to the furniture. This may be safer.

Wishing you a happy gaming experience.
